points.name: Same-day service
points.text: Detailing that fits your schedule, done before sunset.

servicesTitle: Three details. One clear price each.
servicesIntro: Four services, one standard: attention to detail. Prices depend on your vehicle's size, condition and needs.

services.name: Full Service Detailing
services.text: Inside-and-out detailing that restores your showroom shine, from the wheels to the windows.

services.name: Exterior Detailing
services.text: Wash, clay bar, paint polish, then wax or sealant, with wheels, tires and trim finished too.

services.name: Interior Detailing
services.text: Deep cleaning of seats, carpets, mats, dash and door panels, with conditioning for leather and vinyl.

services.name: Ceramic Coating
services.text: A durable barrier against UV, chemical stains and contaminants that makes your paint glossier and easier to clean.

services.name: Window Tinting
services.text: Precision-applied tint film with a bubble-free finish, for UV protection, less glare and a cooler cabin.

services.name: Paint Protection Film
services.text: Partial Front, Full Front, Track Pack or Full Vehicle coverage against scratches, chips and road debris.
